structures.label: Gastrocnemius
structures.function: Points the foot (plantarflexion), most strongly with the knee straight.

structures.label: Soleus
structures.description: Flat calf muscle beneath the gastrocnemius.
structures.function: Points the foot; works hard in running and standing.

structures.label: Achilles tendon
structures.description: Thickest tendon of the body, joining the calf muscles to the heel.
structures.function: Transmits calf force to push off; prone to tendinopathy and rupture.

structures.label: Tibialis anterior
structures.description: Muscle along the front of the shin.
structures.function: Lifts the foot (dorsiflexion) and turns the sole inwards.

structures.label: Fibularis longus & brevis
structures.description: Muscles on the outer leg whose tendons pass behind the outer ankle bone.
structures.function: Turn the sole outwards and protect against ankle sprains.

structures.label: Toe extensors
structures.description: Muscles at the front of the leg with tendons to the toes.
structures.function: Lift the toes and help lift the foot.

structures.label: Plantar fascia
structures.description: Thick band under the sole from the heel to the toes.
structures.function: Supports the arch; inflamed in plantar fasciitis.

structures.label: Tibialis posterior
structures.description: Deep calf muscle whose tendon passes behind the inner ankle bone.
structures.function: Supports the arch and turns the sole inwards.

structures.label: Long toe flexors
structures.description: Deep calf muscles with tendons running under the foot to the toes.
structures.function: Curl the toes and help push off.

structures.label: Sole muscles
structures.description: Short muscles of the sole of the foot.
structures.function: Support the arch and control the toes.

structures.label: Lateral ankle ligaments
structures.description: Three ligaments on the outer ankle (ATFL, CFL, PTFL).
structures.function: Stop the ankle rolling inwards; the ATFL is the most sprained ligament.

structures.label: Deltoid ligament
structures.description: Strong fan of ligaments on the inner ankle.

structures.label: Tibiofibular ligaments
structures.description: Ligaments binding the lower tibia and fibula together.
structures.function: Hold the ankle mortise together; injured in "high ankle sprains".

structures.label: Spring ligament
structures.description: Ligament under the talus between the calcaneus and navicular.
structures.function: Supports the head of the talus and the inner arch.

structures.label: Tibia & fibula (distal)
structures.description: Lower ends of the leg bones, forming the inner and outer ankle bones (malleoli).
structures.function: Form the ankle mortise that grips the talus.

structures.label: Talus
structures.description: Bone sitting between the leg bones and the heel.
structures.function: Transfers body weight from the leg to the foot.

structures.label: Calcaneus
structures.description: Heel bone, the largest bone of the foot.
structures.function: First contact with the ground and lever for the Achilles tendon.

structures.label: Midfoot bones
structures.description: Navicular, cuboid and three cuneiform bones.
structures.function: Form the arches and let the foot adapt to the ground.

structures.label: Metatarsals & phalanges
structures.description: Long bones of the forefoot and the toe bones.
structures.function: Spread load at push-off; site of stress fractures.
